headword: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}

definitions.explanation: The practice of studying or learning at one's own home rather than at school or another institution. Used broadly for homework-style study, remote learning, and self-directed education.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}の{時間|じかん}を{増|ふ}やした。
examples.english: I increased my time spent studying at home.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}の{習慣|しゅうかん}をつけることが{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: It's important to help children develop a habit of studying at home.

examples.japanese: コロナ{禍|か}で{自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}が{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}になった{学校|がっこう}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: During the pandemic, home study became the norm at many schools.

examples.japanese: {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}では{集中力|しゅうちゅうりょく}を{保|たも}つのが{難|むずか}しい。
examples.english: It's hard to maintain concentration when studying at home.

notes:
A compound of {自宅|じたく} (one's home) and {学習|がくしゅう} (study; learning). Became especially common during and after the COVID-19 pandemic as schools and universities shifted to remote formats.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}の{時間|じかん}: home study time
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}の{習慣|しゅうかん}: home study habit
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}{日|び}: home study day (school-designated day for studying at home)
- {自宅|じたく}{学習|がくしゅう}{教材|きょうざい}: home study materials

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家庭|かてい}{学習|がくしゅう}: home study — nearly synonymous, slightly more formal
- {独学|どくがく}: self-study — emphasizes learning without a teacher
- {通信|つうしん}{教育|きょういく}: correspondence/distance education — more structured and institution-based
